## Activity

During October 2020, Harbour Eye Clinic completed 271 captures. Activity was delivered through the scheduled sessions, with lists running as planned apart from routine leave. The available information indicates that capture activity continued without any reported operational disruption beyond this routine staffing arrangement.

## Image quality

Image quality was reviewed as part of the standard process. A total of 13 captures were recorded as ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 4.8. These images could not be used for grading and should continue to be monitored through routine quality assurance processes.

## Grading

Grading outcomes included 58 referable results. The median grading lag was 1 day. Results were processed through the usual grading pathway, with the reported lag indicating the typical interval between image capture and completion of grading. Overall, the activity and grading information provides a summary of service delivery and image quality for October 2020.
